name: LSAT Prep: Syllogra
subtitle: Logic, reading, writing prep
shortDescription: Train arguments, reading and writing for law school admission tests. Argument-map trainer, timed mocks in both formats. Free, offline, no account.
longDescription:
LSAT is a registered trademark of the Law School Admission Council (LSAC). This app is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by LSAC.

LSAT Prep: Syllogra is a practice studio for LSAT preparation: sharpen how you read arguments, read dense passages and write a position under time pressure. Every question is original and written for this app.

### What It Covers
Syllogra is built around the 20 skills that LSAC lists for Logical Reasoning (10) and Reading Comprehension (10). Each skill has at least 8 original questions, 111 Logical Reasoning questions and 12 reading passages with 82 questions in all. A Coverage screen shows every skill with its question count and your progress.

### Reason: Argument Maps and Logic Drills
- Argument-map trainer: label each statement as conclusion, premise, counterpoint or background, draw the arrows, then pick the unstated assumption. 14 maps.
- Drills by question type: main point, method, parallel reasoning, inference, reasoning by analogy, points of disagreement, strengthen, weaken, evaluate, assumption, principle, flaw, resolve the paradox.
- A reason after every answer, including why each wrong choice fails.

### Read: Long Passages
- 12 original passages in law, humanities, social science and natural science, including comparative pairs, with questions on main idea, detail, inference, words in context, structure, application, principles, analogy, attitude and new information.

### Write: Argumentative Writing Practice
- Eight everyday decisions, each with three perspectives. Take a position, engage the others, and use the on-device checklist. Drafts stay on your device.

### Mock: Both Formats
- The current four-section format with an unscored variable section, and the format LSAC has announced from August 2027 (reading first, then two logic sections, with unscored questions mixed in). Timed section by section.
- A score estimate on the 120-180 scale. It is our own estimate from a rough curve, not an official score.

### Adaptive Study
Syllogra tracks how you are doing on each question type on your device, links every missed question to a short primer and a quick check, suggests the next best skill with a one-line reason, and lets you study either by skill or through real-world arguments you map, read about and write.
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
